text:
You remember fragments.
A world with two suns. Fields of amber grain.
Faces you can no longer name.

Then the sky split open.
Something vast descended — a living ship,
all tendrils and bioluminescent veins.
It took everything.

You were catalogued.
Weighed. Measured. Filed away in a pod
of warm amber fluid alongside
hundreds of other specimens.

You don't know how long you slept.
Days. Months. Years.
The ship hums around you —
a heartbeat that is not your own.

Something has gone wrong.
Your pod is cracked. The fluid is draining.
Alarms pulse in colors you have no name for.
The ship's crew is nowhere to be seen.

You are cold. You are weak.
You are alone on a vessel
built to harvest worlds.

Find a way out.
